title: Python Developer with MongoDB
description: Project description The programme is building a resilient, secure, production-grade platform of Python backend services, REST APIs, asynchronous processing components and external integrations, backed by MongoDB and delivered through a React/TypeScript operational user interface with auditable operations and role-based enterprise user journeys. As a Python backend developer with MongoDB exposure, you will design and deliver well-structured, testable, asynchronous backend services and APIs for the platform, with a full-stack delivery mindset – owning features from data model through API to UI. Responsibilities Design well-structured, testable backend services and APIs with clean module boundaries and separation of concerns. Build asynchronous services with FastAPI/Uvicorn and Pydantic-based data modelling. Apply SOLID, object-oriented design and pragmatic design patterns (factory, strategy, repository, adapter, state, saga, outbox, CQRS). Drive design through TDD with strong unit and integration coverage of business-critical paths. Engineer resilience for external dependencies: circuit breakers, retry with exponential backoff and jitter, bulkheads, timeouts and stale-data fallback. Build security into the control flow: OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, RBAC, maker-checker, secrets management. Integrate REST APIs with OAuth2 bearer flows, retries, idempotency and error mapping. Own features end-to-end from data model through API to UI, using Git/GitLab and CI pipelines. Skills Must have Years of experience: 8+ Must have: Strong Python service design: type hints, clean module/package boundaries, separation of concerns. Async Python (asyncio, async HTTP clients) and FastAPI/Uvicorn with Pydantic. SOLID principles, object-oriented service design and design patterns in practice. Test-driven development (TDD). REST API integration: OAuth2 bearer flows, retries, exponential backoff, idempotency, error mapping. Concurrency and distributed-systems correctness: sagas, outbox, FSMs, idempotency, eventual consistency. Full-stack delivery mindset. Git/GitLab, automated testing and CI pipelines. MongoDB (or comparable NoSQL): data modelling, pymongo/Motor, transactions/replica sets, CQRS read models. React + TypeScript SPA: components, state management (TanStack Query / Redux Toolkit), API integration. Containers & Kubernetes/OpenShift: stateless services, config/secrets, leader election in a CaaS environment. Schedulers/workers (Celery, APScheduler, Temporal, Airflow) and leader-election/queue patterns. Nice to have Payments or RTGS/SWIFT domain experience.
